examples.title: Particle effect example - fire and smoke

examples.author: Paweł Jarosz
examples.brief: This example shows a simple setup with a dynamic body physics object and two dynamic wheel physics object joined together with a joint of type "hinge". The hinge joint can simulate an axle or a pin on which other object is rotating in respect to the base. The example shows how to create, destroy and change properties of the joints.
examples.title: Hinge joint physics

examples.author: Paweł Jarosz
examples.brief: This example shows a simple setup with a static pivot and two dynamic weights - physics objects joined together with a joint of type "fixed" and "spring". The fixed joint can simulate a rope and spring joint a spring. The example shows how to create the joints and change the gravity to affect the pendulums.
examples.title: Pendulum physics
